title: Durable, citable and independently auditable preservation of foreseeable-harm warnings and QA findings
origin: User-proposed research principle raised in conversation; summarized and structured for public working research without private case material
thesis: When credible foreseeable-harm concerns, safety warnings, or material QA findings are identified, accountable organisations should preserve retrievable, tamper-evident records so that decisions and corrective actions can be independently examined. Knowing of a risk without appropriate documentation may undermine accountability; it does not automatically establish intent to cause harm.

design_requirements.requirement: Register material warnings with a stable identifier, creation timestamp, subject, evidence source and classification.
Separate factual evidence, interpretation, hypothesis, allegation, review decision and verified outcome.
Record provenance, authority, exact record versions, integrity hashes and correction history.
Maintain redundant backups using independent failure domains; periodically perform and record restore tests.
Preserve append-only or otherwise tamper-evident audit history, while enabling legally required corrections, access controls and retention/deletion.
Provide stable citations and role-appropriate discoverability, including mechanisms for independent scrutiny and appeal.
Track warning acknowledgment, risk ownership, decision reasoning, mitigating action, residual risk and reassessment triggers.
Document access and correction governance to protect personal data, confidentiality, legal privileges and public-interest disclosures.

falsification_and_evaluation.method: Sample registered warnings and verify that a third-party reviewer can retrieve the exact historical version using its public or authorised stable citation.
falsification_and_evaluation.target: define risk-sensitive target before pilot; investigate any missing critical record

falsification_and_evaluation.method: Simulate deletion/corruption of the primary store and attempt restoration from an independent backup.
falsification_and_evaluation.target: preregister restoration objectives and execute drill

falsification_and_evaluation.method: Attempt to alter an earlier decision or warning without adding an explicit correction event.
falsification_and_evaluation.target: zero undetected changes in controlled trials

falsification_and_evaluation.method: Audit warning-to-action links across an agreed time period.
falsification_and_evaluation.target: set threshold with independent governance review

falsification_and_evaluation.method: Inspect sample records for unauthorised personal-data exposure or retention beyond lawful limits.
falsification_and_evaluation.target: zero critical violations in controlled audit

limitations: No storage can truthfully be guaranteed indestructible; design for resilience, independent custody, restoration and integrity verification.
Durable accountability records must remain compatible with justified redaction, correction, privacy law and proportionate retention.
A warning, allegation or hypothesis is not proof that its subject committed wrongdoing.
The proposal has not undergone independent legal, standards or empirical validation.
